mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id AS userId, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.target_id AS targetId, n.from_user_id AS fromUserId, n.is_read AS isRead, n.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS fromUserNickname, u.avatar AS fromUserAvatar FROM notification n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.from_user_id = u.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
